verdict.rationale: 1Password ships an official `op` CLI. It has first-party get-started and reference docs, a documented noun-verb command structure, ongoing releases adding commands, and an official Homebrew cask (v2.39.0). A community user also confirms they use the CLI to access passwords. missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-oriented CLI usage (e.g., machine-readable output or non-interactive agent workflows) in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: 1Password CLI uses a noun-verb command structure that groups commands by topic rather than by operation.
This release adds `op environment secret list`, which lists the name and value of each secret in a 1Password Environment.
the official op CLI is packaged in Homebrew as the 1password-cli cask ('Command-line interface for 1Password', v2.39.0)
Also likes the CLI tool for accessing passwords.
